reader.requirement: At 1985 the USE statement is not an executable statement: it compiles to no action, execution of the program never begins in the declaratives, and a declarative section entered (by the I-O control system or by PERFORM) runs only its procedural paragraphs; a USE statement outside a declarative section header position is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: at 85 the words AFTER and PROCEDURE are required (use-without-after-2002, use-without-procedure-2002); Formats 3 and 4 (EXCEPTION CONDITION / OBJECT) refused below 2002; USE FOR DEBUGGING refused from 2002
sentences after the USE sentence and before the first paragraph-name refused below 2002 (GateLeadingSentences)
the USE FOR DEBUGGING arm (the 1985 debug facility, live only WITH DEBUGGING MODE); the Format-1 arm this rule rides is the same at every edition

reader.edition-search: grep of ProcedureTableBuilder.cs, StatementBinder.cs and DispatchEmitter.cs for CobolVersion, DialectLevel, ConstructRegistry, Permissive; the VersionConformancePass visitors for useStatement and declarativeSection
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the USE sentence is left out of the pc space (leading.Skip(1)) at every edition; only the surrounding format gates differ (AFTER/PROCEDURE required at 85, Format 3/4 refused at 85)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness exercises Format 2 (BEFORE REPORTING) qualification at 85, not that the USE sentence is inert in a Format-1 section reached by PERFORM or by an I-O exception

probes.printed: START N=0 / D1-P N=1 ST1=?? / AFTER-PERFORM N=1 ST1=?? / READ1 N=1 ST1=00 / D1-P N=2 ST1=10 / READ2 N=2 ST1=10 (EXPECT: MATCH)
probes.expected: the program starts at the first nondeclarative statement; PERFORM D1 runs only D1-P (the USE does nothing); the at-end READ without AT END runs the declarative and returns to the next statement (§1985:VII.4.6.4 GR5, GR6)

probes.printed: error COBOL2377: USE ... shall immediately follow a section header in the declaratives portion ... this one is in the nondeclarative portion
probes.expected: a USE statement outside the declaratives is refused (SR1, SR2)

probes.printed: COBOL0900 USE without AFTER requires COBOL-2002; COBOL0877 USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION requires COBOL-2002; COBOL0878 EC-I-O introduced by 2002; COBOL0900 sentence before the first paragraph-name of a declarative section requires 2002
probes.expected: §1985:VII.4.6.2 underlines AFTER; Format 3 does not exist at 1985: each refused

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.6.3 SR2  (4.6.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

reader.notes: ProcedureTableBuilder.DeclCollectSection binds the USE sentence into a DeclScope (BoundDeclarative) and collects only leading.Skip(1) and the paragraphs into the pc space, so the USE itself emits nothing; StatementBinder refuses a USE anywhere else (COBOL2377). Probed by PERFORM of the declarative section and by an I-O exception: both run only the paragraphs.

refuter.evidence: Probes (run_case.py --std 85): r1b.cob (dirs refute-1985-064/r1b-001): three declarative sections D1 (F1), D2 (F2), D3 (F3, zero paragraphs, which SR1 permits); PERFORM D1 THRU D1-P, PERFORM D2, PERFORM D3 (empty) all return; READ past EOF on F1 runs only D1 (no fall-through into D2) and returns to the next statement; OPEN INPUT of a missing F3 runs the empty D3 and returns with ST3=35. Printed START N=0 / D1-P N=1 / D2-P / AFTER-THRU N=1 / AFTER-D3 / D1-P N=2 ST1=10 / AFTER-EOF N=2 ST1=10 / AFTER-OPEN3 ST3=35, as GR5/GR6 require. r1c.cob: a USE sentence carrying a second statement (USE ... ON F1 DISPLAY "IN-USE".) is refused COBOL0897, so no statement can ride in the USE sentence. PERFORM across two declarative sections is refused (COBOL2186) as §1985 PERFORM SR11 also requires. Reader's u2a/u2b/u2c cover the nondeclarative start, USE outside declaratives and 2002 forms. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.4.6.3 SR2 ("The USE statement is never executed"); OK §1985:VII.4.6.4 GR6.
